paragraph: [Presidential Despacho 344/26 of 27 August 2026 authorised USD 13 million for the Plataforma de Interoperabilidade da Administracao Publica](<https://pti.ao/pr-autoriza-13-milhoes-de-dolares-para-plataforma-de-interoperabilidade-da-administracao-publica/>), a secure data exchange channel and API layer between state and private systems. The order calls a public tender. In the last twelve months, [IMA started the USD 150 million Public Digital Infrastructure Project with TIS Angola on 31 July 2026](<https://lidermagazine.ao/revolucao-digital-em-marcha-ima-inicia-projecto-que-vai-mudar-a-administracao-publica/>), to strengthen the interoperability of public systems. No source found since October 2023 says the platform is in service. Establishing would need the platform in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.

[The 2022 appraisal of the US$50 million Digital Foundations Project provided for a national data exchange layer](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/207441655916156350/pdf/Burundi-Digital-Foundations-Project.pdf>), and for its connection to information systems. In the last twelve months, on 17 November 2026 the PAFEN project [issued a request for proposals for a government interoperability platform on the X-Road model](<https://projects.banquemondiale.org/fr/projects-operations/procurement-detail/OP00482177>), funded by IDA. [The tender closes in January 2027](<https://projects.banquemondiale.org/fr/projects-operations/procurement-detail/OP00482177>). No source found since October 2023 says a platform is in service, counts the bodies connected or gives a figure for its use. Establishing would need the platform in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.

[Decree 2020-209 of 18 March 2020 instituted Xroad-BJ, with ASIN managing it and the national interoperability committee supervising](<https://asin.bj/doc/142/download>). ASIN's legal note describes it as Benin's national platform for secure data exchange between administrations' information systems. In the last twelve months, [the dashboard reported 57,322,278 requests in the 12 months to 11 July 2026](<https://statistiques.xroad.bj/>). [In September 2026 an ASIN post counted 75 members, 193 information systems and 542 active services](<https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7506299769514774531>). [An ASIN staff member put the requests through XROAD BJ at 205 million in September 2026](<https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7506299769514774531>).

[UCL's Institute for Innovation and Public Purpose lists Botswana's data exchange system as implemented, fully operational and in use in its DPI Map](<https://dpimap.org/data/>). [The map records the system as publicly owned and points to the page of the Department of Shared Digital Services for it](<https://dpimap.org/data/>). [The map last checked the entry on 1 October 2024](<https://dpimap.org/data/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found names the public bodies whose systems exchange data through the platform, counts the bodies connected or gives a figure for exchanges. Establishing would need the platform in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.

[The digital transition minister launched the national interoperability platform, built on Cybernetica's UXP, in Abidjan on 25 September 2025](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/tech/la-cote-d-ivoire-lance-une-plateforme-d-interoperabilite-pour-fluidifier-l-administration>). In the last twelve months, [on 3 September 2026 the head of SNDI said the platform already improves data exchange between several administrations](<https://www.fratmat.info/article/2644285/economie/transformation-numerique-la-cote-divoire-priorise-les-services-publics-a-fort-impact>). [Five public administrations had joined it by July 2026](<https://digitalmag.ci/cote-divoire-cinq-administrations-publiques-integrent-la-plateforme-dinteroperabilite/>). [The first phase is meant to connect 12 of the 31 bodies judged ready](<https://digitalmag.ci/cote-divoire-cinq-administrations-publiques-integrent-la-plateforme-dinteroperabilite/>). Operating would need ten or more institutions, systems or services connected, counted by a source from the past three years.

In the last twelve months, [at the Cameroon Internet Governance Forum in August 2026, participants stressed the urgent need for a national interoperability infrastructure](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202608/cameroon-eyes-national-interoperability-infrastructure-to-drive-digital-govt>). [The posts and telecommunications minister said the country must move beyond isolated platforms](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202608/cameroon-eyes-national-interoperability-infrastructure-to-drive-digital-govt>). No source found since October 2023 says a platform is under way. None counts bodies connected. Preparing would need a government data exchange platform procured, being built or piloted between a few systems; a framework or law with no platform does not count.

[DR Congo's finance minister said on 3 September 2026 that a data warehouse interconnecting the three revenue agencies is in place](<https://7sur7.cd/index.php/2026/09/03/rdc-les-recettes-mensuelles-de-la-tva-passent-de-1237-plus-de-1414-millions-grace-aux>). Two of the three had loaded their data, and the third was due to join within a month. [He said the E-Finance programme, structured with Huawei, mobilises over US$150 million](<https://7sur7.cd/index.php/2026/09/03/rdc-les-recettes-mensuelles-de-la-tva-passent-de-1237-plus-de-1414-millions-grace-aux>). That statement is the one dated source found in the last twelve months. No source found says the platform is in service carrying data between public bodies' systems, or counts the bodies connected. Establishing would need the platform in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.

[In July 2026 an adviser to the digital economy minister wrote that administrations' systems often do not communicate with each other](<https://www.adiac-congo.com/content/le-numerique-au-service-dun-congo-plus-performant-plus-souverain-et-plus-proche-de-ses>). He said the government wants to build a data exchange platform between administrations. In the last twelve months, [the ministry said Congo is committing to a national digital architecture](<https://numerique.gouv.cg/actualites/architecture-et-digital-public-infrastructure-dpi>), and its [X-Road layer is to link the systems of the Interior, Justice, Finance, Health and Higher Education ministries](<https://numerique.gouv.cg/actualites/architecture-et-digital-public-infrastructure-dpi>). No source found since October 2023 says the platform is in service. Establishing would need the platform in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.

[ANADEN's procurement notice of 12 March 2026 lists an interoperability and data-exchange platform under project COM-1026](<https://www.isdb.org/project-procurement/fr/appels-doffres/2026/gpn/projet-de-modernisation-de-ladministration-publique-comorienne-par-le-bais>). [An Islamic Development Bank loan of 5 million Islamic Dinars finances it, and a consultant is still to prepare its tender documents](<https://www.isdb.org/project-procurement/fr/appels-doffres/2026/gpn/projet-de-modernisation-de-ladministration-publique-comorienne-par-le-bais>). In the last twelve months, [the EU-funded e-Administration project, launched in October 2025, covers interoperability between ministries for secure data sharing](<https://alwatwan.net/societe/modernisation-de-l%E2%80%99administration-publique-i-lancement-officiel-du-projet-e-administration.html>). No source found since October 2023 says the platform is in service. Establishing would need the platform in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.

[NOSi's PDEX lets data owners publish their data as APIs](<https://pdex.gov.cv/>). [It carries live integrations for the civil identification system, NhaCard's traffic with the national health system and the Treasury's DUC system](<https://pdex.gov.cv/>). In the last twelve months, [Biometric Update reported in May 2026 that Cabo Verde launched the Autentika interoperability platform, linking its civil registration and national identity systems](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202605/cabo-verdes-crvs-id-reforms-drive-near-universal-birth-registration>). No source found since October 2023 counts ten or more institutions or systems connected. Operating would need ten or more institutions, systems or services connected, counted by a source from the past three years.

[The e-Governance Academy helped ANSIE set up a national data exchange layer in a project that ended in April 2023](<https://ega.ee/project/djibouti-digital-interoperability-platform/>). [The academy said in 2021 that an X-Road exchange with PKI linked government registries for ANSIE](<https://ega.ee/project/public-administration-modernisation-djibouti/>). In the last twelve months, [in July 2026 the population directorate said it is working on an interoperability system for real-time checks of national ID cards](<https://www.lanation.dj/notre-vision-est-de-faire-de-la-direction-generale-de-la-population-et-de-la-famille-une-administration-entierement-modernisee-interconnectee-et-proche-des-citoyens-abdi-abdillahi-obsie/>). No source found since October 2023 says an exchange platform is in service. Establishing would need the platform in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.

[In February 2026 the High Commission for Digitalisation said ministries had been feeding data into the national interoperability system since 2025](<https://almostathmir.dz/%D8%AD%D9%88%D9%83%D9%85%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D8%B2%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B1-%D8%AA%D8%B9%D8%B2%D9%8A%D8%B2-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%8A%D8%A7/>). In the last twelve months, [the CNRC said in October 2026 that its company-creation portal opens onto an electronic exchange platform](<https://sidjilcom-entreprise.cnrc.dz/acceuil>). It links the CNRC with the tax directorate, CNAS, CASNOS and ONS. No source found since October 2023 counts ten or more institutions or systems connected. Operating would need ten or more institutions, systems or services connected, counted by a source from the past three years.

[In July 2026 the communications minister said government bodies are connected through the Government Digital Transformer](<https://almalnews.com/2126687/>). It allows real-time, secure exchange with more than 100 government databases. In the last twelve months, [the minister said that 105 government bodies are connected through it](<https://almalnews.com/2126687/>). [The tax authority's head said in July 2026 that it exchanges data in real time with 15 government bodies](<https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/4306657>). No source found since October 2023 gives a figure for the exchanges through the platform. Mature would need a source from the past three years giving a figure for exchanges through the platform.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 names a government data exchange platform in Eritrea, whether planned, under way or in service. Nothing found says government systems have no data exchange platform between them. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Absent would need a source from the past three years saying government systems have no data exchange platform between them. Preparing would need a government data exchange platform procured, being built or piloted between a few systems.

[DT Global, an EU-funded adviser, submitted the technical design of the EthioConnect platform in 2024](<https://www.atalayar.com/en/articulo/politics/dt-global-has-supported-ethiopias-digital-government-strategy/20241227125859209382.html>). [It was preparing priority datasets for a pilot, with procurement still to come](<https://www.atalayar.com/en/articulo/politics/dt-global-has-supported-ethiopias-digital-government-strategy/20241227125859209382.html>). In the last twelve months, [in July 2026 an official said a board set up by the prime minister approved a national data exchange platform for government systems](<https://birrmetrics.com/mesob-meets-the-monster-it-was-built-to-kill/>). No source found since October 2023 says the platform is in service. Establishing would need the platform in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.

[The World Bank's December 2024 report set a 2026 target of five government entities exchanging data on Gabon's interoperability platform, against none at baseline](<https://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099121924052032986/pdf/P175987-0914ff29-7941-4230-8202-16cca6789388.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [in September 2026 Gabon was developing an interoperability platform for government information systems to exchange data securely](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/09/09/gabon-four-digital-projects-modernise-public-services/>). [The sixth e-Gabon-SIS and Gabon Digital steering committee reviewed it](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/09/09/gabon-four-digital-projects-modernise-public-services/>). No source found since October 2023 says the platform is in service. Establishing would need the platform in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.

[DIAL says bids for the hub were reissued in 2019 and 2022](<https://dial.global/research/national-data-exchange-ghana-case-study/>). In the last twelve months, [on 21 October 2026 the communications minister said the government is building a national data exchange hub](<https://www.myjoyonline.com/sam-george-announces-national-data-exchange-hub-to-connect-48-public-registries/>), to connect 48 public registries. [An October 2026 analysis says the ministry and NITA are moving to operationalise the hub under the Ghana Digital Acceleration Project](<https://imaniafrica.org/2026/10/the-missing-plumbing-of-the-state-why-ghanas-next-digital-leap-depends-on-a-whole-of-government-data-exchange/>). No source found says the hub is in service or names the bodies the CitizenApp system connects. Establishing would need the platform in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.

[ANDE runs X-Road, the platform meant to let administrations' information systems exchange data](<https://www.africaguinee.com/acceleration-de-la-modernisation-de-ladministration-le-ministre-bourouno-presente-deux-outils-strategiques-au-premier-ministre/>). In the last twelve months, [on 20 August 2026 the minister told the prime minister that the national interoperability portal had been set up](<https://www.visionguinee.info/transformation-numerique-le-ministre-francois-bourouno-presente-a-bah-oury-deux-plateformes-pour-moderniser-ladministration-guineenne/>). [On 24 July 2026 ONECI signed an MoU with NG Tech Innovation for an identity-verification and interoperability platform for the RNPP](<https://horoya.net/2026/07/25/guinee-loneci-et-ng-tech-innovation-sallient-pour-moderniser-lidentification-et-letat-civil/>). No source found since October 2023 says the platform is in service. Establishing would need the platform in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.

[In November 2025 the World Bank recorded no interoperability across the social registry, the education management systems, civil registration and the health insurance system](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099112925154035950/pdf/P179233-79b99711-b6ff-4c20-b5cb-2d5ef7838226.pdf>). [Its target is at least three of those systems interoperable by October 2028](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099112925154035950/pdf/P179233-79b99711-b6ff-4c20-b5cb-2d5ef7838226.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a government data exchange platform is under way. Preparing would need a government data exchange platform procured, being built or piloted between a few systems; a framework or law with no platform does not count.

[From April 2024 to June 2025 a donor-funded pilot built an X-Road test environment with two demo services](<https://cyber.ee/resources/case-studies/cybernetica-piloted-an-interoperability-platform-to-improve-and-optimise-digital-public-services-in-kenya/>). In the last twelve months, [on 23 September 2026 the ICT Cabinet Secretary said a new interoperability platform for government entities to share data is still in development](<https://techweez.com/2026/09/23/kenya-digital-transformation-backend-interoperability/>). [The ICT principal secretary said the same day that the government is building an Enterprise Platform](<https://techtrendske.co.ke/2026/09/23/state-plans-unified-platform-to-link-government-systems/>). No source found since October 2023 says the platform is in service. Establishing would need the platform in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.

[The World Bank's GREAT Project report lists a new Service Bus for data exchange among government systems, including the National Identification Registry](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099110625073415416/pdf/P177478-9397c8d1-edb6-4a96-a39d-0222e717f2c4.pdf>). [No system used it at 30 September 2025, against a target of ten by December 2030](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099110625073415416/pdf/P177478-9397c8d1-edb6-4a96-a39d-0222e717f2c4.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [the project's 2026 procurement plan lists a US$50,000 consultancy to design and configure a Government Service Bus prototype](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099021326063510836/txt/P177478-d6a96244-44d6-44c4-855d-bbbd85a9394e.txt>). No source found since October 2023 says the platform is in service. Establishing would need the platform in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.

[In April 2026 the General Information Authority described the National Data Distributor as a sovereign platform for secure data exchange between entities](<https://www.gia.gov.ly/en/2026/04/23/enhancing-digital-transformation-in-the-business-sector-joint-meeting-to-launch-the-electronic-system-of-the-chambers-union-and-align-it-with-national-frameworks/>). In the last twelve months, on 1 June 2026 the communications authority's chairman said [the Distributor links the banking sector, government agencies and service sectors](<https://lana.gov.ly/post.php?id=358533&lang=en>). [It recorded over 300 million data transactions in 2025](<https://lana.gov.ly/post.php?id=358533&lang=en>). No source found since October 2023 counts ten or more bodies connected. None names the bodies whose data passes through it. Operating would need ten or more institutions, systems or services connected, counted by a source from the past three years.

[UCL's DPI Map, as last checked in October 2024, lists Lesotho's data exchange system as implemented and in use](<https://dpimap.org/data/>). In the last twelve months, [in February 2026 a review at the ICT ministry heard X-Road presented as a system to connect government ministries](<https://www.gov.ls/ict/micsti-and-nul-advanced-lesotho-digital-public-infrastructure/>). [The ministry and UNICEF held a workshop in Berea on 20 to 23 October 2026 to plan an X-Road pilot](<https://www.africa-newsroom.com/press/the-government-of-lesotho-remains-committed-to-strengthening-secure-data-exchange-across-government-institutions-and-enhancing-service-delivery-for-basotho?lang=en>). No primary source found since October 2023 says the platform is in service. None names the bodies whose systems it connects. Establishing would need the platform in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.

[The Agence de développement du digital says Jisr carries secure data exchange between public administrations and institutions](<https://www.lavieeco.com/au-royaume/plateforme-jisr-55-millions-doperations-dechange-de-donnees-enregistrees-en-une-annee/>). [In October 2025 the minister described the national interoperability platform as already in place](<https://leseco.ma/maroc/connectivite-5g-et-e-gouvernement-amal-el-fallah-seghrouchni-fait-le-bilan-de-la-transformation-numerique.html>). [The agency says Jisr recorded more than 55 million data exchange operations from February 2023 to 31 January 2024](<https://www.lavieeco.com/au-royaume/plateforme-jisr-55-millions-doperations-dechange-de-donnees-enregistrees-en-une-annee/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. [In April 2025 the Agence de développement du digital said more than 76 bodies were connected to the national interoperability platform](<https://www.lavieeco.com/tech/add-silence-on-digitalise/>).

[L'Express reports that Rahaka was already operational at five bodies at its launch on 28 April 2026](<https://www.lexpress.mg/2026/04/administration-mise-en-place-dun.html>). They are EDBM, CNaPS, Instat, the Ministry of Justice and the tax directorate. In the last twelve months, in April 2026 [14 institutions were connected to the national exchange system](<https://2424.mg/modernisation-de-letat-14-institutions-deja-interconnectees-via-le-systeme-dechange-national-et-extension-vers-des-secteurs-vitaux-en-perspective/>), 2424.mg reports. The administrative reform programme reports [more than 162,000 exchanges recorded through the system](<https://2424.mg/modernisation-de-letat-14-institutions-deja-interconnectees-via-le-systeme-dechange-national-et-extension-vers-des-secteurs-vitaux-en-perspective/>). Sources differ on the count at launch: five bodies in one report, 14 institutions in another.

[The health ministry's SIS-MA has an interoperability platform with live links to the medicines-logistics system and the Ministry of Justice's civil registration system](<https://sisma.misau.gov.mz/interoperability.html>). In the last twelve months, [in June 2026 ATDI said INATRO, the civil identification directorate and the Ministry of Justice were joining the national interoperability platform](<https://noticias.karingana.co.mz/2026/06/26/atdi-e-bau-alinham-visao-de-servicos-publicos-digitais-integrados-e-centrados-no-cidadao/>). [In October 2026 ATDI trained 25 technicians from nine public bodies to join their systems to X-Road](<https://mznews.co.mz/mocambique-reforca-integracao-digital-do-estado-atraves-da-tecnologia-x-road/>). No source found since October 2023 counts ten or more institutions or systems connected. Operating would need ten or more bodies connected, counted by a source from the past three years.

No stage is set. No source found since October 2023 dates the service, connections or use of InfoHighway, the exchange platform live since 2016. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says that government systems have no data exchange platform, or that one is in service. Establishing would need a source from the past three years saying the platform is in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.

[The World Bank says its Digital Foundations Project of 2017 to 2024 built the Bomalathu exchange platform](<https://www.worldbank.org/en/results/2025/06/23/digitalizing-afe-malawi-to-improve-access-to-education-public-services-and-income-opportunities>). [In 2025 the e-Government department had not made the Enterprise Service Bus operational](<https://times.mw/the-year-ict-sector-grappled-with-implementation-woes/>). In the last twelve months, [in June 2026 the ICT ministry proposed a data sharing regulation for Boma Lathu, the National Data Exchange Platform](<https://itweb.africa/article/malawi-devises-operational-rules-for-national-data-exchange-platform/xnklOvz1R2bq4Ymz>), which ITWeb describes as under implementation. No source found since October 2023 says the platform is in service. Establishing would need the platform in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.

[Cybernetica says Namibia has implemented Nam-X for secure data exchange between organisations](<https://cyber.ee/resources/case-studies/namibia/>). [The World Bank wrote in October 2023 that the population register links public and private registries through X-Road](<https://blogs.worldbank.org/en/nasikiliza/legal-identity-all-what-can-madagascar-learn-namibia>). In the last twelve months, [a project begun in 2024 continues scaling the platform and is adding two digital services to it](<https://cyber.ee/resources/case-studies/namibia/>). [UNDP said in 2025 that the government is deploying NamX for inter-ministry sharing](<https://www.undp.org/namibia/blog/season-3-namibias-digital-identity-journey-vision-reality>). No source found since October 2023 counts the bodies connected. Operating would need ten or more institutions, systems or services connected, counted by a source from the past three years.

[WURI-Niger's third component funds interoperability and secure data exchange between the base ID system and service providers' systems](<https://www.lesahel.org/presentation-du-projet-didentification-unique-pour-lintegration-regionale-et-linclusion-en-afrique-de-louest-wuri-niger-un-projet-pour-renforcer-l/>). [Its World Bank financing of about USD 81 million came into force on 19 August 2021](<https://www.lesahel.org/presentation-du-projet-didentification-unique-pour-lintegration-regionale-et-linclusion-en-afrique-de-louest-wuri-niger-un-projet-pour-renforcer-l/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the platform is built or in service. Establishing would need the platform in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.

[UCL's DPI Map, as last checked in October 2024, lists the NGEA API gateway as Nigeria's data exchange system and as fully operational](<https://dpimap.org/data/>). In the last twelve months, [in March 2026 Gofore consultants set up NGDX's first X-Road instance in Abuja](<https://haus.fi/en/topical/gofore-supports-nigeria-in-digital-public-infrastructure-dpi-development/>), where first uses were agreed but not live. [In May 2026 an EU-funded EUR 23 million agreement tasked ESTDEV with building an X-Road exchange layer](<https://estdev.ee/en/articles/estonia-and-finland-join-forces-implement-eu-digital-governance-project-nigeria>). No primary source found since October 2023 says the platform is in service. None names the bodies the NGEA gateway connects. Establishing would need the platform in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.

[In March 2025 the social registry shared household data with other institutions through the government enterprise service bus](<https://spdci.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Talking-Interoperability-18-Rwanda_vFinal_Updated.pdf>). [The government told the World Bank its Government Enterprise Service Bus is in use](<https://datacatalog.worldbank.org/search/dataset/0037889/govtech-dataset>). In the last twelve months, [in October 2026 RISA said a Shared Government Data Hub and a Data Interoperability Platform are being worked on](<https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/39395/news/health/africa-needs-to-take-charge-of-its-digital-health-systems-says-minister>). No source found counts ten or more bodies connected to the bus; the registry exchanged data with seven systems. Operating would need ten or more institutions, systems or services connected, counted by a source from the past three years.

The digital ministry [describes Baldna as the national unified platform for data exchange and government transactions](<https://baldna.gov.sd/>). In the last twelve months, [in September 2026 the ministry and the National Investment Authority put a needs-disclosure service live on it](<https://atheernews.net/222149/>), linking the industry, transport and agriculture bodies to Customs. The Baldna home page [counted more than 48 government institutions on the platform](<https://baldna.gov.sd/>) on 11 November 2026. It also [reported more than 265,785 completed transactions](<https://baldna.gov.sd/>), 148 of them between government bodies. The counts come from the platform's own home page, and no other source has been found to check them.

[At the WSIS Forum 2026 a government presenter said PINS, built on X-Road, has launched a minimum viable product with two use cases](<https://dig.watch/event/wsis-forum-2026/new-technological-deal-or-or-how-a-global-south-digital-strategy-for-impactful-ict-transformation>), social protection and public finance. [In January 2026 the ministry said the pilot links the social registry, health insurance, civil status and identity card systems](<https://pins.sn/actualites/2026-01/plateforme-interministerielle-et-interoperable-dechange-de-donnees-du-senegal>). In the last twelve months, [on 24 September 2026 the ministry called for a study of the infrastructure the future PINS platform needs](<https://guindima.sn/news/article/appel-a-manifestation-dinteret-etude-des-besoins-en-infrastructure-de-la-plateforme-dinteroperabilite-nationale-pins/>). No source found says PINS is in service. It has two pilot use cases. Establishing would need the platform in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.

[The World Bank's 2025 terms of reference say the finance systems run standalone, with no service bus](<https://wbgeprocure-rfxnow.worldbank.org/rfxnow/waffle/upload/advertisementAttachment/603116/file.html>). In the last twelve months, [in August 2026 the NCRA head said the Ministry of Finance is piloting a national Data Exchange Layer based on X-Road](<https://sierraloaded.sl/news/ncra-urges-identity-approach-sierra-leones/>). [A May 2026 tender asks the tax system's supplier to integrate with the Government Service Bus](<https://mof.gov.sl/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/REoI-for-Tax-System_RUSLP.pdf>). No source found since October 2023 says the platform is in service. Establishing would need the platform in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.

[The finance ministry's PFM Reform Strategy 2026-2030 makes a central data exchange platform a priority](<https://mof.gov.so/sites/default/files/Publications/Somalia%20Public%20Financial%20Management%20Reform%20Strategy%20-%20March%2031.pdf>). [GovStack said in 2024 that no interoperability platform had been developed and every agency runs its own systems](<https://govstack.global/showcase/digital-leaders-spotlight-rwanda/>). In the last twelve months, [in March 2026 the finance ministry said lack of interoperability between PFM IT systems limits consolidation of financial information](<https://mof.gov.so/sites/default/files/Publications/Somalia%20Public%20Financial%20Management%20Reform%20Strategy%20-%20March%2031.pdf>). No source found since October 2023 says the platform is in service. Establishing would need the platform in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.

[In September 2025 a World Bank mission saw live demonstrations of prototypes of the DEX interoperability and data-exchange platform](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099102025185177863/pdf/P177158-d0ebd79d-6646-4e92-b9ae-1183b632c15a.pdf>). [Ooru is building it with INIC and DGRN](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099102025185177863/pdf/P177158-d0ebd79d-6646-4e92-b9ae-1183b632c15a.pdf>). [In April 2025 the World Bank counted no government systems on the national data exchange layer, against five by May 2027](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099041125035024996/pdf/P177158-11847402-82b3-4460-9bf4-0fe106ed4291.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says the platform is in service. Establishing would need the platform in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.

[UCL's Institute for Innovation and Public Purpose lists Eswatini's data exchange system as planned or piloted in its DPI Map](<https://dpimap.org/data/>). [The map names the e-Government Unit as the body that owns the system](<https://dpimap.org/data/>). [The map last checked the entry on 1 October 2024](<https://dpimap.org/data/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says a government data exchange platform is in service, or names the bodies it would connect. Establishing would need the platform in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.

In the last twelve months, [in October 2026 a World Bank project information document said Seychelles has no interoperability layer between government systems](<http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099100726053521931>). [It said that gap keeps government services on manual processing](<http://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/099100726053521931>). No source found since October 2023 says a platform is under way. None counts bodies connected. Preparing would need a government data exchange platform procured, being built or piloted between a few systems; a framework or law with no platform does not count.

[The map last checked the entry on 1 October 2024](<https://dpimap.org/data/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says a government data exchange platform is in service, or names the bodies it would connect. Establishing would need the platform in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.

[Togo's 2025 presentation says the RSIA inter-administration exchange network entered a pilot in late 2024, due to end in mid-2025](<https://www.id4africa.com/2025/files/T1-P2-S1-3_TOGO-final.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [the identification agency's May 2026 deck sets out an API and data-sharing platform on RSIA, built on X-Road](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-2-4-Togo-FINAL.pdf>). [It is to link the agency with ministries, banks and hospitals, with consent, audit logs and sign-in by national ID](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-2-4-Togo-FINAL.pdf>). No source found since October 2023 says the platform is in service. Establishing would need the platform in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.

[The Centre National Informatique runs the national interoperability platform, which carries citizen register data to civil status, schools, universities, training and health bodies](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-3-2-Tunisia-FINAL.pdf>). [Cybernetica says phase 1 brought UXP to five key ministries and institutions](<https://cyber.ee/resources/news/phase-2-tunisia-interoperability/>). In the last twelve months, [a 2026 playbook charted yearly exchanges of citizen register data with state bodies, rising to 900,125,547 in 2025](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-3-2-Tunisia-FINAL.pdf>). No source found since October 2023 counts ten or more bodies connected. Operating would need ten or more institutions, systems or services connected, counted by a source from the past three years.

[The e-Government Authority's 2024 roadmap says public institutions use GovESB to exchange information](<https://www.ega.go.tz/uploads/standarddocuments/sw-1710314957-SIGNED%20e-Government%20Technology%20Roadmap%202024%20(1).pdf>). [In June 2025 the e-Government Authority said more than 180 public institutions were connected to GovESB, with more than 200 systems exchanging data through it](<https://www.ega.go.tz/news/waziri-mkuu-azindua-mfumo-wa-govesb>). In the last twelve months, [in January 2026 officials called GovESB the backbone for secure data exchange across ministries](<https://www.monitor.co.ug/uganda/news/national/tanzania-s-govtech-success>). No source found since October 2023 gives a figure for the exchanges through the platform. Mature would need a source from the past three years giving a figure for the exchanges or transactions through the platform.

[NITA-U's page says UGHub is fully operational, connecting government systems for real-time data sharing](<https://www.nita.go.ug/services/e-government-services/integration-service-ughub>). In the last twelve months, [in June 2026 NITA-U said UGHub connects 37 percent of government agencies](<https://www.nita.go.ug/news-updates/nita-u-launches-strategic-plan-fy202526-fy202930-boost-reach-digital-government>). [In July 2026 it reported 168 organisations exchanging information through the platform, 70 public and 98 private](<https://ict.go.ug/media/news/familiarisation-visit-highlights-nita-us-digital-progress>). [On 1 October 2026 a NITA-U specialist said UGHub connects NIRA's identity registry to agencies and private bodies](<https://www.newvision.co.ug/category/news/nira-to-register-learners-correct-identity-er-NV_241639_102026>).

[National Treasury launched the one-year MzansiXchange pilot on 9 October 2025 with 11 partner institutions](<https://www.gov.za/news/media-advisories/government-activities/national-treasury-launches-mzansixchange-pilot-9-oct-03>). In the last twelve months, [by January 2026 testing was under way between SASSA, NSFAS, DPSA and Home Affairs](<https://www.gov.za/sites/default/files/gcis_document/202601/operation-vulindlela-q3-report-2026.pdf>), and [in October 2026 ITWeb said MzansiXchange was still largely a pilot](<https://www.itweb.co.za/article/citizen-services-project-mymzansi-gets-r150m-boost/lLn14MmQNEYMJ6Aa>). [In October 2026 SAnews, citing Operation Vulindlela's progress report, said the pilot should be completed in December 2026](<https://www.sanews.gov.za/south-africa/operation-vulindlela-implementation-continues-make-strides>). No source found since October 2023 says the platform is in service. Establishing would need the platform in service, carrying data between two or more public bodies' systems.

[ZamPortal says the Government Service Bus integrates government institutions, departments and agencies](<https://zamportal.gov.zm/director-sibulowa-introduces-the-gsb/>). In the last twelve months, [in July 2026 the Accountant General's office said more than 400 government services had joined the Government Service Bus, ZamPortal and ZamPay](<https://itweb.africa/article/digital-services-strengthen-zambia-finances/JBwEr7n3zk3M6Db2>). [In April 2025 the Smart Zambia Institute said 4.5 million transactions had passed through the Government Service Bus in three years](<https://znbc.co.zm/news/govt-service-bus-handles-k5bn-in-transactions/>). [The minister said it recorded 1.2 million transactions in 2025](<https://www.zambiamonitor.com/world-bank-calls-on-zambia-to-step-up-investment-in-digital-infrastructure-skills/>).
